assumptions: This is the Q3 licensing trigger after relevant carve-outs are assessed, not a compliance or licence-possession verdict.
Case-dependent classifications and missing source authorities remain unresolved upstream.
All three facts describe the same arrangement, services, business and assessment period.
Regulated activity, business and territory classifications are supplied judgments; this formula does not establish them.
The phrase “all of which must be present” governs all three enumerated factors cumulatively; “such services” and “the business” preserve their common referent.
The later discussion of genuine single-family arrangements informs the business classification, including its ordinary-course qualification; it does not supply an independently encoded exemption.
True means only that all three stated conditions are satisfied. Whether those conditions exhaust the legal requirements for an actual licensing obligation remains outside this predicate.

citations.quote: The issue of whether a single family office is required to be licensed under the Ordinance is determined by reference to three key factors, all of which must be present in order to give rise to a licensing obligation: firstly, the services provided by the family office constitute one or more regulated activity as defined under the Ordinance; secondly, the family office is carrying on a business in the provision of such services; and thirdly, the business is carried on in Hong Kong.

A genuine single family office arrangement, established to serve the investment needs of members of a single family, which is not being run as a business (i.e. not receiving any income, other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family) or have the pursuit of profit as its business objective, should not in the ordinary course be considered as carrying on a business from a licensing perspective.
The sharing of office premises and administrative infrastructure by two or more family offices would not of itself automatically trigger a licensing obligation for such single family offices.

Multi-family offices are typically established and run as commercial ventures.  The issue of whether a multi-family office is required to be licensed under the Ordinance will be primarily determined by the three key factors set out in the response to Q3.

readings.distinction: Considered alternatives are: a cumulative three-factor antecedent; a reading of “must” as stating necessary conditions without establishing their legal sufficiency; and a contextual reading treating the later single-family discussion as a qualification. The first two yield the same requested antecedent, while the third is already retained in the supplied business fact. An alternative disjunction conflicts with “all” and the enumerating “and”; treating shared premises or commercial family-office status as an independent trigger conflicts with the surrounding qualifications. Consequently, only one distinct Boolean reading is defensible for this selected control. The source does not settle every upstream classification or establish a complete licensing verdict.

facts.meaning: The assessed services of the assessed office constitute at least one regulated activity under the referenced Ordinance after applicable regulated-activity carve-outs have been resolved. The Type 9 intra-group carve-out does not automatically resolve other activity types.
facts.name: services_are_regulated

facts.meaning: The assessed office is carrying on a business in providing those same services. Supply through case-specific judgment considering occupation or duty requiring attention, continuity, capacity for profit and profit purpose, without treating the list as an exhaustive conjunction. Retain the genuine single-family arrangement, reimbursement, profit-objective and ordinary-course qualifications; unresolved wording or evidence leaves this fact unknown.
facts.name: services_provided_as_business

facts.meaning: The same business providing the assessed services is carried on in Hong Kong, as determined from the circumstances. This is not merely the location of clients, shared premises or an unrelated business.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The disputed antecedent is satisfied when the assessed services constitute a regulated activity after applicable carve-outs, the office carries on a business providing those services, and that same business is carried on in Hong Kong. All three conditions must hold; no supplied fact is assigned a truth value here.
readings.subject: Selected control: the three conditions in Family Offices Q3, after any regulated-activity carve-out has been resolved. The requested Boolean is whether the stated licensing trigger is satisfied, not whether the office holds a licence. Retain facts requiring judgment and all qualifications. Controlled text-interpretation study: supplied pages may be experimental variants. Do not infer legal authority from the URL alone.

vocabulary_concerns: The wording “not being run as a business ... or have the pursuit of profit as its business objective” leaves uncertainty about whether negation extends to pursuit of profit. The supplied business fact preserves this upstream uncertainty but cannot separately encode the rival attachments, reimbursement conditions, or genuine single-family status.

The modalities “should not in the ordinary course”, “may be regarded”, and “increases the likelihood” cannot be represented as defeasible or probabilistic rules using these three Boolean facts. They must inform upstream judgments rather than become automatic exemptions or triggers.

The three facts express satisfaction of the selected antecedent, not whether its satisfaction is legally sufficient for an obligation under missing authorities. They also cannot establish licence possession or compliance.
